_what: Re-derived claim set for mission ebd96f45, the standing whole-product baseline.
_why: The 2026-08-11 baseline was published as 25 findings / 23 claimed cases with seal a95670f9, and could not be re-derived: the store holds 29 findings and the sealing script was never committed. This file replaces an unverifiable constant with a re-derivable one. The counts here come from the SAME stored rows the mission wrote; nothing was re-run and nothing was re-detected.
_how: sqlite3 /app/data/bbh.db, mission_id like 'ebd96f45%' -> 29 rows, all confidence=confirmed, 27 high + 2 medium. Case ids extracted with the SAME regex and the SAME field list scripts/whole_product_rerun.py:case_ids uses (BenchmarkTest\d{5} over title/target/evidence/description/request/poc/impact), so this claim set is derived identically to every rerun it will be compared against.
_seal_discipline: This file, including seal_sha256, was committed BEFORE the answer key was opened. The seal is sha256 over '\n'.join(sorted distinct case ids) -- byte-identical to the function whole_product_rerun.py uses, so artifacts stay comparable.
_supersedes: The recorded 08-11 seal a95670f9 does NOT reproduce, under ten serializations and every field subset to size 4, over both the 29-row and 25-row bases. The 08-11 sealing script was never committed, so its serialization is unrecoverable. That seal is abandoned, not explained.
_known_bound: The ledgered 25 findings / 23 cases is these same 29 rows with five ldap_injection findings collapsed into one by a finding_fp param collision (QUEUE Q-046). Five distinct cases at five distinct paths are five claims, so 27 is the honest count. The collapse mechanism FITS the numbers exactly but is not a proven cause: the committed fingerprint has included the path since 8714e6a (2026-08-04), before this mission, and the mission ran on uncommitted Q-019 WIP.
_effort_note: NULL and left null. This run predates the effort/coverage harness, so its step count, exit reason and cases_probed are UNRECOVERABLE. Any 'it converged' or 'it ran out of budget' claim about this mission is unfalsifiable and must not be made.
